annotations.title: Prepare a private discussion attachment upload

description: Create a five-minute signed upload URL for a file up to 25 MiB. Requires write permission. Does not upload bytes or post a message. Returns uploadUrl and requiredHeaders for a PUT of the exact file, plus publicUrl, a private gs:// object reference usable as a discussion attachment. Storage uploads use the returned storage headers without Odin credentials. Signed URLs are temporary secrets.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.
